name: GitHub Copilot
description: Run GitHub Copilot agents with your Copilot account.

methods.label: GitHub Copilot personal access token
methods.whenToUse: Authenticate the GitHub Copilot agent runtime with a personal or explicitly shared account.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a personal fine-grained token with the Copilot Requests permission. Copilot authentication is separate from GitHub repository and MCP access. [GitHub authentication instructions](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-cli/set-up-copilot-cli/authenticate-copilot-cli).

credentialFields.label: Personal access token
credentialFields.helperMd: Use a personal fine-grained token with Copilot Requests permission.
